changelog: Replace C3 to explicitly and concisely require checking for a missing clause core (addresses finding: missing predicate/clause core raises contra).
Paraphrase C4 to shorten and sharpen the warning that cuts leaving only introductory/subordinating material are high-risk (addresses finding: preverbal/subordinate fragments).

Change C6 to add a compact, actionable rule treating tightly bound name/title and noun+modifier packages as cohesion atoms and to warn to sharply reduce cohesion if split (addresses finding: splitting multiword/name/title units).
Paraphrase C8 to a shorter reminder to think in structural terms, reducing length while preserving guidance.
Replace Example E1 with the measured labeled example en_us_1591 to teach the model about name/title cohesion directly (per critique: prefer measured examples for this signal).
Delete Example E3 (hand-written) to recover space and ensure the edit set reduces prompt size sufficiently.

Replace Example E1 with labeled example en_us_1591 to teach the model to avoid cutting inside names/titles and keep multiword name/title units intact (addresses finding: splitting multiword/name/title units).
Replace Example E2 with labeled example en_us_1102 to show the danger of cuts that leave preverbal or predicate fragments (addresses finding: missing clause core / high contra).

Replace Example E3 with labeled example en_us_1192 to illustrate cohesion loss when cuts split quantifier/list frames and to discourage cutting list/quantifier structures (addresses finding: quantifier/list splitting).
